exposure: Patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorder
cohort: 130 patients who underwent peripartum hysterectomy (PH) during delivery and/or within 24 h of delivery
finding: The peripartum hysterectomy rate was 0.75 per 1000 births, and the maternal mortality rate was 7.6 per 1000 hysterectomies, with placenta accreta spectrum disorder being the most common indication for PH.
mod_finding: This study did not examine mode of delivery as an outcome or risk factor, but it did report the modes of delivery among women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy.
